free_tier.stated: A free welcome credit is granted to a new account with no card required: the sign-up page states USD 20 welcome credit, USD 8 after email verification and USD 12 after the first day. A no-signup try sandbox runs for 5 minutes, then is deleted, and allows network only to package registries.
free_tier.notes: The operator list's $0.108/h is the Pro/Team rate for a 2 vCPU / 4 GB sandbox: $0.032 per vCPU-hour plus $0.011 per GB RAM-hour. Pay as you go is $0.038/vCPU-hour plus $0.013/GB-hour, which the pricing table gives as $0.128 for the same box.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the metered unit is a running Firecracker microVM, not a stored object; the free plan offers up to 6 hours per sandbox and 10 vCPU / 10 GB RAM in total

retention.stated: An idle sandbox falls asleep and keeps its files at no CPU or memory cost; on pay as you go it is kept 7 days, extendable to 14, and its disk bills at $0.06 per GB-month above the plan allowance.

egress.terms: A sandbox has full internet, an allowlist or no network, with IPv4, IPv6 or both, and a public HTTPS URL for any port; the pricing page states no separate egress volume allowance or per-GB price.

interface_detail: A REST API at https://sandbox.wbx.cz/v1, a Python SDK and a TypeScript SDK, an MCP server at https://sandbox.wbx.cz/mcp for AI assistants, a terminal command, and a portal; sandboxes are Firecracker microVMs hosted in the EU.
tooling: The user installs the Python or TypeScript SDK or calls the REST API; MCP lets a coding agent drive sandboxes without a client of its own.
chaining: USD 20 of welcome credit and a per-job price ceiling let an agent run bounded code tasks and batches, with sleeping named sandboxes that keep files between runs.

limits.value: USD 20 welcome credit on sign-up, paid by usage at $0.038/vCPU-hour and $0.013/GB-hour on pay as you go; 10 concurrent sandboxes, 10 vCPU / 10 GB RAM total, up to 6 hours per sandbox
The no-signup try sandbox is limited to 5 minutes, smallest compute and disk, and network only to PyPI and npm

limits_note: Fixed-price plans are Solo $15/month (3 concurrent, 6 vCPU / 8 GB total, 4 h per sandbox), Pro $49/month with $25 usage credit (25 concurrent, 24 h), and Team $99/month with $50 credit (100 concurrent, 48 h); all prices exclude VAT.
binding_note: Welcome credit and then prepaid balance are what run out first: when credit is exhausted new sandboxes stop starting while running ones finish normally, well before the concurrency cap matters.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for Your name, Email and a password of at least 10 characters, plus terms acceptance; Google and GitHub sign-in are offered. 'No card required.' Billing details (country, company) are asked only when paying, by card through Stripe or GoPay for EU customers. The no-signup try sandbox needs 'no account, no card'.

reliability_note: When credit runs out new sandboxes stop starting and the user is emailed; running sandboxes finish normally. Idle sandboxes sleep and are deleted after the plan's retention period (2 days' email warning); paid sandboxes falling asleep after 30 minutes or 10 minutes without a command stop running programs but keep files.
confidence_note: The rate table, welcome credit, sign-up fields, sleeping-sandbox retention and no-signup trial are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-25. Egress volumes are not published.
